results.title: Direct v_rotate Bypass
results.attack: Seller or attacker calls vault.v_rotate directly on the seat sub-account to hijack ownership without going through registry.
results.control: Vault derives parent registry ID from env::current_account_id() and rejects any non-registry caller.

results.title: Seller Drains Vault While Seat is Listed
results.attack: Seller lists a seat showing 2 NEAR inside the vault, then calls vault.withdraw right before the buyer's transaction lands.
results.control: v_list switches vault status to Listed (Frozen); authorize_withdraw rejects all owner and delegate outflows while listed.

results.title: Bait-and-Switch Relist (Lower Balance Guard)
results.attack: Seller cancels a listing that promised min_balance = 0.9 NEAR, drains the vault, and immediately relists at the same price with min_balance = 0.
results.control: Every v_list increments monotonic listing_nonce; buy_seat and v_settle_sale verify the exact nonce quoted by the buyer.

results.title: Pre-Sale Delegate Backdoor
results.attack: Before transferring or selling a seat, seller appoints an accomplice or AI bot via set_delegate to drain funds after the sale.
results.control: Delegate is bound to rotation_seq and wiped on every apply_rotation; post-transfer calls fail immediately.

results.title: Divert Unclaimed Pool Payout to Seller Wallet
results.attack: Seller calls registry.claim(token_id) hoping the accrued Pool Anggota share is sent to their personal wallet before selling.
results.control: registry.claim always transfers to Promise::new(token_id) (the seat vault sub-account), never to caller or owner_id.

results.title: Sale in the Middle of a Payout Race
results.attack: Ticket payout, claim, buyer settlement, and seller withdrawal interleave across blocks during a sale.
results.control: Checked across all 75,600 receipt interleavings (s1_sale_in_the_middle_of_a_payout) + cross-contract test: vault is frozen during listing and any payout landing in the vault belongs to the seat.

results.title: Former Owner Withdraws After Transfer
results.attack: After nft_transfer or buy_seat completes, former owner attempts to call vault.withdraw or set_delegate.
results.control: Canonical owner_id and rotation_seq live in the vault and update atomically in a single receipt.

results.title: Vault Balance Below Buyer's min_balance Guard
results.attack: Buyer purchases a seat whose vault withdrawable balance is lower than the buyer's required min_balance guard.
results.control: v_settle_sale checks withdrawable >= max(listing.min_balance, buyer.min_balance) in the settlement receipt; on failure, on_sale_settled credits 100% of buyer's deposit to the pull refund ledger.

results.title: Re-Initialize Vault or Swap Pinned Vault WASM
results.attack: Attacker calls vault.init again to reset owner, or calls registry.pin_vault_wasm to swap the seat contract code.
results.control: NEAR #[init] rejects re-initialization, vault.init requires predecessor == parent registry, and pin_vault_wasm locks permanently after first pin.

results.title: Double-Transfer / Stale Sequence Race
results.attack: Seller fires two concurrent transfers or races a transfer against a listing.
results.control: v_rotate requires expected_seq == vault.rotation_seq; the first receipt increments rotation_seq, causing the second to abort.

results.title: Lagging Index / Rollback Sync Exploit
results.attack: Callback runs out of gas leaving registry index behind vault; former owner tries to exploit stale index or roll sync backwards.
results.control: Permissionless registry.sync(token_id) reads vault_state() and advances index only when vault.rotation_seq > index.seq; gate fails closed on divergence.

results.title: nft_transfer_call Rollback Drain & Self-Buy
results.attack: Attacker uses nft_transfer_call to spend from vault inside nft_on_transfer and then revert the NFT transfer, or seller buys own listing.
results.control: nft_transfer_call is unconditionally disabled (K5 -> E_UNSUPPORTED) and buy_seat rejects buyer == seller (E_BUYER_IS_SELLER).
